newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in Kansas on Thursday. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady with late Wednesday sales of mostly $1.00 lower than the bulk of Wednesday sales, USDA said.
Inquiry and demand light. Sales confirmed on 7700 slaughter steers and 4300 slaughter heifers Thursday.
For the week to date 70500 head confirmed including 19400 head or about 28 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1250 lbs
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1200 lbs
Confirmed: 12000 last week: 3200 last year: Holiday
week to date: 70500 last week: 89000 last year: 52600
